eval: (async () => { const r = await fetch('/examples/01-文本传递.json'); const j = await r.json(); window.__comfyGraph.loadWorkflow(j); return 'loaded'; })()

(() => { const g = window.__comfyGraph; const node = Object.values(g.graph._nodes).find(n => n.type === 'TextInput'); const [gx, gy] = node.getConnectionPos(false, 0); const rect = g.canvas.canvas.getBoundingClientRect(); const va = g.canvas.visible_area; const sx = Math.round(rect.left + (gx - va[0]) * g.canvas.ds.scale); const sy = Math.round(rect.top + (gy - va[1]) * g.canvas.ds.scale); const c = g.canvas.canvas; const mk = (type, x, y, buttons) => c.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent(type, { clientX: x, clientY: y, button: 0, buttons, bubbles: true, cancelable: true, view: window })); mk('mousedown', sx, sy, 1); return JSON.stringify({ pos: [sx, sy], afterDown: { connecting: !!g.canvas.connecting_node, type: g.canvas.connecting_output && g.canvas.connecting_output.type, slot: g.canvas.connecting_slot } }); })()

(() => { const g = window.__comfyGraph; const c = g.canvas.canvas; const mk = (type, x, y, buttons) => c.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent(type, { clientX: x, clientY: y, button: 0, buttons, bubbles: true, cancelable: true, view: window })); mk('mousemove', 760, 200, 1); mk('mousemove', 950, 640, 1); return JSON.stringify({ stillConnecting: !!g.canvas.connecting_node }); })()

(() => { const g = window.__comfyGraph; const c = g.canvas.canvas; const before = Object.keys(g.graph._nodes).length; document.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mouseup', { clientX: 950, clientY: 640, button: 0, buttons: 0, bubbles: true, cancelable: true, view: window })); return JSON.stringify({ before, after: Object.keys(g.graph._nodes).length }); })()
